utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I think the first thing is sorting what’s broken and what we can fix quickly.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll start sorting the broken items and flag the quick fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the time, the exact drop-off spot, and whether we need any tools or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, I can confirm that—just send me the time and exact drop-off spot, and I’ll check whether tools or supplies are needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can do that—once you tell me the time and exact drop-off spot, I’ll send them over.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might’ve missed the details, so what’s the plan?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, right — I think we’re gathering the broken stuff first, then sorting it out near the community shed. I’d better check the exact time again, just to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll swing by the shed once you’ve checked the time. Just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to help out at the repair drive, and I’ll let folks know what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds good, Vik — I’ll spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — that helps a lot. I’ll keep checking in and pass along any updates on what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — if you’ve got a drill, a hammer, or any extension cords, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ve got a drill and a hammer I can bring over right now. Need anything else?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—what time are we starting, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re starting at 9 a.m. on Saturday, and if you can bring a drill, a hammer, and a few work gloves, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 9 a.m. Saturday works for me. I’ll bring the drill, hammer, and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, are we collecting tools first or just cash for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Let’s collect both if we can — tools will help a lot, and cash can cover what we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — what should I ask folks to bring, and where should we drop everything off?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad to help with the repair drive — who still needs a hand?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let me check my list — I’ve got a few neighbors still needing help. I’ll tell you the names and where they are.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’m ready when you are — just send me the names and locations, and I’ll help coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — could you handle signups and keep a simple list of who’s bringing tools or supplies? That’d help me a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll handle the signups and keep a simple list of who’s bringing tools or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we already have and what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, that’d help a lot. Just keep it quick—I’m trying to keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep it quick—I'll check the supplies and let you know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely—people are dropping off tools, paint, and a few handy supplies. If you want, I can keep an ear out for what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Tess. I’d appreciate that—I’ll ask around a bit too and see what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, Rey—I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if I hear what they’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details one more time? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — I’ll send the repair drive details again so you have the latest version. Thanks for helping out with it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Faye — send the latest details when you’re ready, and I’ll double-check them before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just send me the time and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll text you the time and a quick list of what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks—I'll watch for your text.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll let folks know about the repair drive and keep repeating the plan so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that’ll really help keep everyone on the same page. I’ll keep sharing the details too so the repair drive stays clear for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the plan and make sure folks know where to go and when.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but I can help if you remind me what changed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. We’re still collecting repair items, but I can remind you of the list if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yes, please—remind me of the list, and I’ll keep an eye out for anything I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help out with the repair drive. Just tell me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Rey — thanks. We still need help sorting donations and checking the bikes, if you’re up for it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can do that. I’ll start with the donations, then take a look at the bikes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad we’re kicking this off, Opal. I’ll organize the repair drive list and keep everyone posted on what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep track of where each repair item needs to go and note any updates as we go.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll start the list and share the first batch of repair needs with you soon. Just send me any updates as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the timing, the drop-off point, and whether we need to bring anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the timing, drop-off point, and a quick list of anything to bring as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that would help a lot — please send it when you have it, and I’ll plan around that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this repair drive is definitely happening, right? I just want to make sure before I tell anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d want to double-check the details before I say for sure, but I’m happy to confirm what I can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so it’s not fully confirmed yet, right? I’ll hold off on spreading it until we know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—what needs fixing, and when are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late to the details, but I can help sort it out. If you’ve got the list of repairs, I’ll jump in and we can set a start time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me—I'll gather the repair list and bring it over. Then we can pick a start time and stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s getting organized — do you know what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what’s still short, but I haven’t seen the full list yet. If you want, I’ll ask around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d help a lot — I’m mostly hearing bits and pieces, so I’d appreciate the update when you get it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was just about to check what still needs doing. If you need a hand, I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren — I’d really appreciate that. Let’s check the list together and see what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — let’s take a look and I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye — it starts at 9:00 Saturday morning at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll work around that and make sure it fits the school schedule.
